displayName: OCI-WSTG01-002: Web Server Fingerprinting via Headers
description:
Detects verbose server headers disclosing technology stack versions enabling targeted attacks

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg01_002", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%web%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%server%') AND "value" > 0
